outgoing.name: 9th century
outgoing.excerpt: MS 47673) is an early 9th century illuminated Gospel Book that was produced at the Schuttern monastery in Baden.

outgoing.name: Latin
outgoing.excerpt: The manuscript contains the text of the four Gospels in Latin along with the Eusebian canon tables, prefaces, summaries and capitulary.
